about_the_game:
In Pizza Del Gatto, form a team of pizza-making cats with up to 5 friends in an online co-op fantasy environment. Work together to craft and deliver pizzas across a sprawling kingdom, communicating closely to guide your pals on ferocious scooter mounts and ensure orders reach the right clients. Make quick decisions on prioritizing deliveries to optimize your time and maximize rewards, some pizzas are worth more than others!

Roam the kingdom to discover cool artifacts and rare toppings for secret recipes. In this open world packed with hidden spots, you can cruise around on your scooter, jamming to chill tunes, while your friends yell directions over the chaos. Get ready for a cooperative, stressful, and richly detailed adventure in pizza delivery.

The Cat's Kingdom

Cats in the kingdom are always on the move, craving fast and delicious food. How convenient that you and your friends run the only pizza place that delivers to every village! But stay alert, these villages teem with quirky inhabitants like strange cats, guards, zombies, wizards, and who knows what else? Navigate encounters wisely to keep your deliveries on track.

Environment

The kingdom is a vibrant open world brimming with secret areas and thrilling spots for parkour and exploration. Leap around using your scooter, jumping pads, or a combo of both for epic maneuvers. While teamwork is key, if communication breaks down, you can always give your friends a playful push (severe punch) sending them ragdolling hilariously far away!

Key Features

  • Online co-op for 1-5 players.

  • Fantasy-themed pizza crafting with customizable recipes and rare ingredients.

  • High-stakes delivery runs with time management and prioritization.

  • Exploration in a dynamic open world with hidden collectibles and Easter eggs.

  • Chaotic fun: Push mechanics, scooter stunts, and ragdoll physics for lighthearted sabotage.
